1	#!/usr/bin/env node
2	/** Snapshot-only Loader driver: stream one fixture turn as canonical JSONL. */
3	
4	import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
5	import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
6	import { installModelSelection, type ModelSelectionRef } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent'
7	import { SessionId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'
8	import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model'
9	import { installFailLoud, loadEnv, resolveConfigPath } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot'
10	import { runFixtureTurn } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-loader-smoke'
11	import type { SessionEvent } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'
12	import { bootProductionProfile } from './production-profile.ts'
13	
14	const NAME = 'base-test-driver'
15	const [configPath, ...taskParts] = process.argv.slice(2)
16	if (configPath === undefined || taskParts.length === 0 || taskParts.every(part => part.trim() === '')) {
17	  throw new Error(`${NAME}: expected <config-path> <task...>`)
18	}
19	
20	const uninstallFailLoud = installFailLoud(NAME)
21	let ctx: Context | undefined
22	try {
23	  loadEnv(NAME)
24	  const patchInput: unknown = configPath.startsWith('[') ? JSON.parse(configPath) : [configPath]
25	  if (!Array.isArray(patchInput) || !patchInput.every((path): path is string => typeof path === 'string')) {
26	    throw new Error('base test driver requires a patch path or JSON array of patch paths')
27	  }
28	  ctx = await bootProductionProfile({
29	    binName: NAME,
30	    overlayPaths: patchInput.map(path => resolveConfigPath(path, undefined)),
31	  })
32	  if (ctx.agents.roots().length === 0) {
33	    const selection = ctx.agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()
34	    await ctx.agents.create({
35	      sessionId: SessionId(`session-${randomUUID()}`),
36	      meta: { cwd: process.cwd() },
37	      agentOptions: { provider: selection.provider, model: selection.model },
38	      setup: (agentCtx) => {
39	        const selected: ModelSelectionRef = { current: selection, assembled: undefined }
40	        installModelSelection(agentCtx, selected)
41	      },
42	    })
43	  }
44	  const result = await runFixtureTurn(ctx, {
45	    task: taskParts.join(' '),
46	    onEvent: (sessionId: string, event: SessionEvent) => {
47	      process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ type: 'session_event', sessionId, event })}\n`)
48	    },
49	  })
50	  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(result)}\n`)
51	} catch (error: unknown) {
52	  process.stderr.write(`${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}\n`)
53	  process.exitCode = 1
54	} finally {
55	  await ctx?.fiber.dispose()
56	  uninstallFailLoud()
57	}
58
